articles.title: Disclosure Day Grey Alien UFO / UAP Occupant design explorations shared by Concept Artist Daniel Baker!
articles.summary: Disclosure Day Grey Alien UFO / UAP Occupant design explorations shared by Concept Artist Daniel Baker! | Disclosure Day Movie News Disclosure Day Grey Alien UFO / UAP Occupant design explorations shared by Concept Artist Daniel Baker! Concept artist Daniel Baker provided a number of alternative designs for Disclosure Day's take on the classic Grey Alien and THEIR UFO/UAP occupants. One of the prominent concept artists who got to work on Steven Spielberg's Disclosure Day was Daniel Baker and recently he's taken to social media to debut some of the phenomenal artwork he provided for the film! Below are a few explorations he shared of the film's take on the classic Grey Alien – a slender humanoid extraterrestrial with large eyes, pale skin and a frail body.

articles.title: New waivers may provide critical insight into UAP claims: Avi Loeb
articles.summary: The Pentagon’s new waiver allows current and former service members, personnel and contractors with access to UAP‑related National Defense Information to speak openly about what they know, superseding nondisclosure and Special Access Program agreements. Avi Loeb, head of the UAP Science Advisory Council, said the information would still need to be disclosed behind closed doors, so some details could remain off‑limits. He noted the waiver could enable disclosures on recovered non‑human craft, but that depends on the nature of the information and that the government may still hold undisclosed evidence. The waiver is seen as a potential key step toward full UAP disclosure, though it is unclear what evidence the government actually possesses and what will remain classified.

articles.title: Drone Or UFO? Unidentified Object Spotted Over Tehran Leaves Internet Searching For Answers
articles.summary: In September 2026, videos of an illuminated object moving across Tehran’s night sky were shared on social media, showing bright lights but lacking detail on size, speed, or height. The footage has prompted speculation that the object could be a drone, an aircraft, or a UFO, but no reliable evidence confirms its origin or affiliation. Iranian authorities have not publicly identified the object, and the videos do not provide enough information to determine its exact location or nature. Some viewers suggested it might be a drone, a distant plane, or an LED‑lit kite, while others linked it to military activity amid heightened tensions with the US. The sighting coincides with the 50th anniversary of a 1976 Tehran incident involving an unidentified object that was investigated by fighter jets, but no evidence connects the two events.

de.title: Drohne oder UFO? Unbekanntes Objekt über Teheran gesichtet verlässt das Internet auf der Suche nach Antworten
de.summary: Im September 2026 wurden in den sozialen Medien Videos eines beleuchteten Objekts geteilt, das sich über den Nachthimmel von Teheran bewegte und helle Lichter zeigte, aber keine Details zu Größe, Geschwindigkeit oder Höhe enthielt. Das Filmmaterial hat zu Spekulationen geführt, dass es sich bei dem Objekt um eine Drohne, ein Flugzeug oder ein UFO handeln könnte, aber es gibt keine verlässlichen Beweise für seine Herkunft oder Zugehörigkeit. Die iranischen Behörden haben das Objekt nicht öffentlich identifiziert und die Videos liefern nicht genügend Informationen, um seinen genauen Standort oder seine Natur zu bestimmen.
